description: This file defines the LeaveApplicationService class, which manages leave application processes including applying for leave, validating leave periods, handling leave entitlements, and dispatching leave events within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeaveApplicationService
classes.description: Service class for handling leave applications, including applying for leave, validating leave periods, managing leave entitlements, and dispatching related events.

methods.name: applyLeave
methods.description: Creates a new leave application after validating maximum allowed period, overlapping leaves, and work shift length.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Saves the leave request, handles leave entitlements, comments, and dispatches leave application events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines leave status based on whether the date falls on a weekend, holiday, or requires approval.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether leave balance can be exceeded; returns false.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForApplyAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow state machine item for the apply leave action.
